description: This PHP source file defines the 'Authorize' controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages customer authorization workflows such as login verification, token generation, sending authorization codes, resetting authorization attempts, confirmation, and unlocking customer accounts. The class includes methods for handling AJAX requests and page rendering related to customer authorization security features.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class handling customer authorization processes including token management, verification, and account unlocking.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the authorization page, generates tokens, and loads necessary assets and data for customer authorization.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to send authorization codes to the customer via email.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submitted authorization code, validates attempts, updates authorization status, and redirects upon success or failure.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Displays the account unlock page if authorization attempts exceed the limit, allows customer to reset authorization.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms authorization link, generates a reset token for account recovery, and provides feedback.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Resets the customer's authorization token and account status, effectively unlocking the account and clearing session data.
